dynamicTools.name: fixture_lookup
dynamicTools.description: Return a fixed marker for the given probe. Reads and changes nothing.

config:
model = "fixture-v2"
model_catalog_json = "$ROOT/codex-home/fixture-models.json"
model_provider = "fixture"
approval_policy = "on-request"
sandbox_mode = "read-only"
check_for_update_on_startup = false
suppress_unstable_features_warning = true

[features]
hooks = true
multi_agent = true
multi_agent_v2 = true
# The curated plugin marketplace sync clones a GitHub repository at startup.
plugins = false
apps = false

[analytics]
enabled = false

[model_providers.fixture]
name = "Fixture"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:43239/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
request_max_retries = 0
stream_max_retries = 0

[projects."$ROOT/workspace"]
trust_level = "trusted"

response.message: direct app-server input is not allowed for multi-agent v2 sub-agents
